title: Boron family and electron-deficient compounds
basic_overview: Boron forms electron-deficient molecules and multicentre bonds. BF₃ is a classic Lewis acid.

extra_info_content.step_by_step: 1. Count electrons. 2. Draw skeleton. 3. Identify bridge. 4. Use multicentre bond.
extra_info_content.factors: B₂H₆ contains bridging H atoms; BF₃ is trigonal planar and becomes tetrahedral on donor coordination.
extra_info_content.kinetics_or_energy: Compare thermodynamic driving force with kinetic barrier when relevant; do not treat a favourable ΔG° as proof of a fast reaction.
